desc: The ADM UIC MOD 1 is a rifle designed to perform reliably and without compromise in law enforcement-style shooting scenarios. The USA-made American Defense Manufacturing UIC MOD 1 features fully ambidextrous controls, including a right-side bolt catch, release lever, left side magazine release and a Radian Weapons Talon Ambi Safety Selector, ADM’s HD Buffer and ten position buffer tube, an ALG Defense QMS Trigger, and a 20-degree competition style mag well. Combine these elite attributes with a Radian Weapons Raptor-LT Ambidextrous Charging Handle, a highly accurate 4150 CMV Rosco Bloodline MFG Barrel, and an M-LOK handguard, and you have a weapon of unparalleled performance.
